# SHIVOHARA Technologies

> SHIVOHARA Technologies is a premium software engineering company based in Bangalore, India. We build scalable, intelligent digital ecosystems — from custom web and mobile applications to AI/ML integrations, ecommerce platforms, and enterprise-grade database architectures.

## Company Overview

- **Full Name:** SHIVOHARA Technologies
- **Website:** https://shivoharatechnologies.com
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Headquarters:** Bangalore (Bengaluru), Karnataka, India
- **Email:** shivoharatechnologies@gmail.com
- **Phone:** +91 7981230713
- **Founder:** Uday Sankar Nasina
- **Industry:** Software Development, IT Services, AI/ML
- **Clients Served:** Startups, SMBs, Enterprises — Worldwide

## What We Do

SHIVOHARA Technologies combines cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence with robust, high-scale software engineering. We translate complex business requirements into sleek, intelligent, and scalable digital products. The word "SHIVOHARA" stands for infinite consciousness and transformation — and we channel that energy into engineering excellence.

## Services

### Software Development Services

1. **Web Application Development**
   - Custom SPA & SSR architectures (React.js, Next.js, Vue.js)
   - Admin dashboards, SaaS platforms, interactive portals
   - Progressive Web Apps (PWAs)
   - Optimized Core Web Vitals (LCP & INP metrics)
   - Responsive, mobile-first designs

2. **Mobile Application Development**
   - Native iOS development (Swift)
   - Native Android development (Kotlin)
   - Cross-platform development (Flutter, React Native)
   - App Store & Play Store release orchestration
   - Fluid UI with native-level performance

3. **Ecommerce Solutions**
   - Secure, highly transactional ecommerce platforms
   - Advanced payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal)
   - Dynamic inventory management systems
   - High-speed checkout flows
   - Custom catalog scaling for large product databases

4. **Database Architecture & Services**
   - PostgreSQL schema design and optimization
   - NoSQL database solutions (MongoDB, Redis, Firebase)
   - Database sharding and read-replication
   - Real-time data synchronization
   - Data warehousing and migration

5. **Automated Testing & QA**
   - End-to-end (E2E) test suite design
   - CI/CD pipeline integration
   - Unit, integration, and visual regression testing
   - Security auditing and penetration testing
   - Load and performance testing

6. **Digital Marketing & SEO**
   - Technical SEO audit and optimization
   - Search engine marketing (SEM)
   - Conversion rate analytics and optimization
   - Targeted campaign marketing
   - Content strategy and social media management

### AI & Machine Learning Lab

7. **AI and ML Applications**
   - Custom LLM (Large Language Model) tooling
   - Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems
   - Image recognition and computer vision
   - Reinforcement learning integrations
   - Production-ready AI with low-latency inference

8. **AI and ML Research Projects**
   - Specialized model fine-tuning
   - Multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph)
   - Vector search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
   - Custom neural architectures for niche industries
   - Benchmarking and experiment documentation

9. **Data Science Projects**
   - Predictive analytics and forecasting
   - Visual analytics dashboards
   - Business intelligence (BI) solutions
   - End-to-end data engineering pipelines
   - Statistical modeling and A/B testing

10. **AI Workflow Automation**
    - Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
    - Smart document routing and classification
    - Automated customer support assistants
    - Intelligent business process automation
    - AI-powered decision engines

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript
- **Mobile:** Flutter, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), React Native
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, Python, Django, FastAPI
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Supabase
- **AI/ML:** TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI API, Hugging Face, Custom LLMs
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Vercel, Render, Docker, CI/CD
- **Testing:** Jest, Cypress, Selenium, Playwright, k6

## Portfolio / Projects

1. **Founder's Mart** (https://ecellstore.com) — A gamified student marketplace and e-commerce platform developed for Alliance University's Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell).

2. **Velish** (https://velish.in) — A campus food ordering and smart cafeteria management platform designed for colleges and universities. Features AI-powered recommendations.

## Scaling Approach

SHIVOHARA builds products that scale from MVP to enterprise:

- **MVP / Startup Stage:** Fast, lightweight serverless configurations, single database hubs, rapid feature delivery for user acquisition
- **Growth Stage:** Load-balanced microservices, regional CDNs, automated testing pipelines, cached database queries
- **Enterprise Stage:** Multi-region redundancy, globally synchronized databases, autonomous AI agents, extreme high-concurrency tolerance
